Your plate, by the pound
Grab a plate

Start cold, at the salad bar.

Greens, vegetables and Brazilian sides. Take as much or as little as you like, because you only pay for what goes on the plate.

Keep going

Then the hot buffet.

The day's hot dishes, all in one line. Mix and match without ordering a thing.

Stop at the grill

The grill master carves it for you.

Meat comes straight off the skewer onto your plate, sliced while you wait.

Save room

Dessert, then the scale.

Weigh the plate, pay, and sit down. That is the whole system.

From the grill
